item.content:encoded: From Axis of Ordinary — Links for 2026-11-20: Independent checkers accept Claude-assisted Riemann proof — Levent Alpöge released a Lean proof of the classical Riemann hypothesis and its generalization to Dirichlet L-functions, developed with Claude.
